findings.current:
A gap of sixteen Levels. It was overwhelming. As if to drive that fact home, the System chimed.

Ding.
findings.defect: The English renders the System alert twice: once through “chimed” and again through the standalone “Ding.” The source contains only the narrated alert here, without a separate 띠링 sound-effect line.
findings.rationale: Unlike the earlier alerts at lines 9 and 69, this passage has no standalone 띠링. Adding “Ding.” after already translating 시스템창이 울렸다 duplicates the auditory beat.
findings.replacement: A gap of sixteen Levels. It was overwhelming. As if to drive that fact home, the System chimed.

summary: Faithful overall, with one minor duplicated System sound effect.
